section_summary.extract_value: This introduction discusses achievement goal theory, differentiating between mastery and performance goals, and their approach-avoidance dimensions. It reviews general outcomes associated with mastery-approach, performance-approach, mastery-avoidance, and performance-avoidance goals, noting a meta-analysis finding that performance-approach goals predict academic achievement more robustly than mastery-approach goals. The paper and its present studies will focus on the two approach goals (mastery-approach and performance-approach).
